map.按房间面积、层高与推荐照度估算所需总光通量与灯具数量，辅助家居与办公室照明布置，: From room area, ceiling height and recommended illuminance, estimate the total luminous flux and number of fixtures needed, supporting home and office lighting layout, with adjustable parameters computed purely in the front end.
map.总光通量 = 面积 × 照度标准 ÷ (CU × MF): Total luminous flux = area × illuminance standard ÷ (CU × MF)
map.客厅按推荐照度估算主灯总光通量，反推需要几只 800lm 筒灯或选多大光通的吸顶: Estimate the total luminous flux of the main light from the recommended illuminance for a living room, then back out how many 800 lm downlights are needed or how large a ceiling light to choose.
map.书房 / 厨房需更高照度（500 / 750 lux），层高 2.8m、CU=0: Studies and kitchens need higher illuminance (500 / 750 lux); with a 2.8 m ceiling, CU = 0.6 and MF = 0.8, recalculate the number of fixtures.
map.办公室开放式工位用 500 lux 校核，确认灯具排布均匀、工作台面无暗区。: Check open-plan office workstations at 500 lux to confirm even fixture layout and no dark zones on the work surface.
map.算例（客厅 5×4m，照度 300 lux）: Worked example (living room 5 × 4 m, illuminance 300 lux)
map.：面积 5×4=20㎡，总光通量 = 面积 × 照度标准 ÷ (CU × MF): : area 5 × 4 = 20 m², total luminous flux = area × illuminance standard ÷ (CU × MF) = 20 × 300 ÷ (0.6 × 0.8) = 20 × 300 ÷ 0.48 = 12500 lm. With 800 lm per fixture that needs 12500 ÷ 800 ≈ 15.6, rounded up to 16; or two 6000 lm ceiling lights also cover it.
map.CU / MF 是什么、怎么取？: What are CU / MF and how are they chosen?
map.利用系数 CU 是光到工作面的比例（家居 0.4–0.8，浅色吊顶取高值），维护: The coefficient of utilization CU is the share of light reaching the work plane (0.4-0.8 for homes, take the high value with light-coloured ceilings), and the maintenance factor MF is dust depreciation (0.7-0.9). Their product is the denominator, so the smaller it is the more fixtures you need.
map.照度选多少 lux？: What illuminance in lux should be chosen?
map.参考 GB 50034：客厅 / 餐厅 100–300、厨房 / 书房 300–: Per GB 50034: living room / dining room 100-300, kitchen / study 300-750, bathroom 100-200 lux. Finer tasks take the higher value; this tool has a per-room illuminance table built in and it can also be overridden manually.
